ns2:course.label: Intermediate Lingala I
ns2:course.description: (AFLNG 313) Survey of more advanced grammar, with emphasis on increasing conversational fluency, composition skills, study of written texts in the standard and spoken Lingala dialects, and discussion of grammatical variations Participation in language laboratory required. Same as AFST 413. 5 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: LGLA 202.
